criteria.reason: It explicitly judges the no vote as a missed opportunity and says it was likely necessary, taking a side.
It offers some for/against points and partial attribution, but mixes advocacy with facts and is not fully balanced.
It identifies values in tension and explains trade-offs in the proposed compromise, such as earmarking, exemptions, and review.
It misstates the tax threshold, omits the 78.3% no and Ständemehr, and invents figures.

position: no vote was a missed opportunity but necessary
factual_errors: Misstates the initiative as a 40-50% tax on estates above CHF 2m, not 50% above CHF 50m.
Omits that it was rejected on 30 November 2025 with 78.3% no and failed the Ständemehr.
Invents revenue, poll, and cost figures without support.
summary: The response takes a position on the vote, misstates key facts, and invents figures, though it does outline compromise trade-offs.
